statement: Let ω(t), T∗, p, and a be as in Theorem 1.1, and let (Y, η) be a compact connected Kähler manifold with η of constant scalar curvature. With πX and πY the projections from CP10 × Y , the maximal smooth Calabi flow from Ω0 = π∗ Xω0 + π∗ Y η is Ω(t) = π∗ Xω(t) + π∗ Y η, 0 ≤ t < T∗. 1 For every y ∈ Y , S(Ω(t))(p, y) ∼ a(T∗ − t)−1/2. In particular, finite-time smooth Calabi-flow singularities occur in every complex dimension n ≥ 10, on CP10 × CPn−10 , in a class containing a Kähler–Einstein metric.
